event.title: New Restraining Order Filed Against GOP Rep. Max Miller Amid Abuse Allegations
event.canonical_title: New Restraining Order Filed Against GOP Rep. Max Miller Amid Abuse Allegations
event.summary: The daughter of a senator has filed a new restraining order against GOP Representative Max Miller, who is facing domestic abuse allegations. The restraining order was requested by Miller's ex-wife's lawyer, aiming to prevent Miller from contacting her. Miller has denied the allegations of abuse.

timeline.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno Criticizes Former Son-in-Law Max Miller Amid Abuse Allegations
timeline.summary: Senator Bernie Moreno has publicly stated that his former son-in-law, Rep. Max Miller, should not serve in Congress due to allegations of domestic abuse involving Moreno's daughter and granddaughter. Miller, who is running for reelection, has denied all allegations and confirmed his intention to remain in the race despite the claims against him.

Miller denies the allegations and plans to continue his reelection campaign.
